blocks.text: Derive maximum CAC and break-even ROAS from contribution margin, repeat purchases, and refunds before launching a campaign. blocks.title: Simple analogy
blocks.text: CAC, ROAS, LTV, margin, and test budget is like arranging a physical shop: every color, space, message, or offer should help a visitor understand where they are, what they can buy, and why they can trust the next step.

Derive maximum CAC and break-even ROAS from contribution margin, repeat purchases, and refunds before launching a campaign. Name the precise problem before selecting a tool. prerequisites: Complete the web foundations or know how to open the project, edit a file, and verify the result in a browser. No previous commercial experience is required.
objectives: Turn Attribution, consent, and responsible remarketing into concrete, measurable decisions that can be applied to a real store.
Turn a consent-respecting advertising measurement plan into concrete, measurable decisions that can be applied to a real store.

Turn Understand attribution windows and models, deduplication, consent, platform limits, and incrementality tests without excessive surveillance. into concrete, measurable decisions that can be applied to a real store.

blocks.text: Understand attribution windows and models, deduplication, consent, platform limits, and incrementality tests without excessive surveillance. A sound decision always connects the customer need, the visual or commercial rule, its implementation in the site, and an observable signal. This prevents vague preferences and copied tactics whose purpose is not understood.

blocks.title: Simple analogy
blocks.text: Attribution, consent, and responsible remarketing is like arranging a physical shop: every color, space, message, or offer should help a visitor understand where they are, what they can buy, and why they can trust the next step.

Understand attribution windows and models, deduplication, consent, platform limits, and incrementality tests without excessive surveillance. Name the precise problem before selecting a tool. Observe context, device, intent, and customer objections. Then write a hypothesis that links one change to an expected result without presenting that hypothesis as established fact.

To master Attribution, consent, and responsible remarketing, first build a minimal version with explicit rules, then inspect it on mobile and desktop. Contrast normal, empty, long, and error cases. Quality comes from a coherent testable system, not from accumulating visual effects or promotional messages.

This lesson delivers a consent-respecting advertising measurement plan. It must record the starting situation, decision, expected evidence, and safety limit. Compare behavior and before/after metrics over enough time while accounting for traffic, costs, and satisfaction.
